### Brush and canvas improvements

- Improve brush preview handover so the finished stroke is not blended again while its preview clears, reducing extra darkening and flashes with modes such as Hard Light.
- Make Square and Diamond tips respect AA-off, with pixel-aligned edges and cursor outlines that refresh when tip settings change.
- Reduce pixel-grid drawing overhead at 800% zoom by reusing small repeating textures. Keep the grid visible above brush previews while preserving its appearance settings.
- Add 256 px and 512 px brush size presets, and remove the extra Opacity and Flow reset buttons.

### Interface and input

- Keep the canvas in place when switching docked tool options or showing the bar's scrollbar. Respect theme transparency, opacity, corners and separator settings.
- Keep ordinary controls from showing a pressed state on a right-click. Existing context menus and right-click actions are preserved.
- Use the same blend mode descriptions in layer, brush, shape and text selectors.
- Add Preferences > Pen & Tablet with pressure settings, input guidance and a scratch area for testing without changing a document.

Related to issues 223, 224 and 225.
